title: Architecture Patterns & Principles
intro: Architecture-pattern interviews test whether you can choose a structure and defend it. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with architectural styles (the landscape — monolith, layered, microservices, event-driven), then the two most-asked patterns — clean architecture and hexagonal (ports & adapters) — then domain-driven design (the strategic patterns: bounded contexts, aggregates). Microservices patterns follow at the applied tier, then the comparison canon, then scenario-based design questions. It closes with CQRS and event sourcing — the advanced patterns that separate architects from developers.
